svg.title: California brown pelican cycling along the coast
svg.desc: An illustrated California brown pelican in full breeding plumage rides a teal bicycle. A golden crown, white neck stripe, chestnut hindneck, blue eye, red expandable throat pouch, silver-edged gray-brown wing feathers, and webbed feet distinguish the bird. Both spoked wheels rotate clockwise. Two jointed legs alternately drive opposite pedals and the crankset. The animation repeats every 2.4 seconds without scripts or external resources.
